title: ladder/1 (draft, from docs/architecture/d1-roster-data.md section 5)
description: data/fighters/<id>/ladder.json: the power ladder (D1b). DRAFT: derived from the plan before any data exists; the field names are a guess and will change when D1b lands. Version field: schema. Policy: the top level is closed except keys starting with an underscore; the per-tier deltas and the power-up coefficients are open tables of numbers.

thresholds.description: Fill levels at which each tier begins; strictly increasing (checked by tools/lib/xref.js).

tiers.description: Per-tier deltas, for example speed, damage and launch force.
